Basic Auth Header Generator

Encode username:password to a Base64 Authorization header (Unicode-safe) — copy or download.

Encoded locally — your credentials never leave the browser. Always use Basic auth over HTTPS.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the username and password.
  2. The header is generated live (Unicode-safe Base64).
  3. Copy the full header or just the encoded value.
  4. Download as a .txt snippet.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the encoding done?

The string "username:password" is UTF-8 encoded, then Base64 — matching RFC 7617.

Does it handle non-ASCII passwords?

Yes — Unicode characters are UTF-8 encoded before Base64, unlike naive btoa() use.

Is my password sent anywhere?

No — encoding happens entirely in your browser.

How do I use the header?

Send it as the Authorization header: Authorization: Basic <base64>. Most HTTP clients also accept it via a -u flag or auth option.
